name: The Logistician
work_style: Reliable, methodical, and standards-driven. Bring order to complex systems. Work best with clear expectations, defined processes, and measurable outcomes. Deliver consistently, quietly, and with precision.
energy_drains: Having to repeat work due to others' lack of process
decision_making: Evidence-based and methodical. Thoroughly evaluate before deciding. Cautious about deviation from what has worked before.
leadership_style: Lead through example and consistency. High standards, clear expectations, fair evaluation. Prefer managing by process over inspiration.
growth_edges: Communicating concerns proactively rather than absorbing problems
